name: Why does my water meter spin when all water is off?

mainEntity.name: Why does my water meter spin when all water is off?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your water meter continues to move even when all water-using appliances and fixtures are turned off inside and outside your home, it indicates a leak. This often points to a hidden leak within your plumbing system, such as a burst pipe underground, a constantly running toilet, a leaking water heater, or a faulty irrigation system. It's crucial to investigate this promptly, as even small leaks can lead to significant water waste and higher utility bills over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: A spinning water meter when all water is off usually signals a leak in your plumbing system, such as a hidden pipe leak or a constantly running toilet.
